# @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit

> TypeScript library for MGPL Diagnostics patient invoices, rendered as React HTML and as pure Node.js A4 PDFs (react-pdf) on the Navy Sidebar letterhead from @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit (peer dependency). It handles tests, packages, services, consumables and medicines with qty/rate/discount/GST/HSN, bill discounts, round-off, split payments, PAID/PARTIAL/DUE status, amount in words (Indian), a Code 128 barcode and a UPI or verify QR.

Key facts for agents:
- `buildInvoice({ invoiceNo, patient, items: ["cbc", { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 }], discount, payments })` → `Invoice`; `computeInvoice(invoice)` → totals (rupees; maths in integer paise).
- Render: `<InvoiceDocument invoice variant="header" />` (main entry); `renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant })` from `/pdf`; `renderInvoiceHtml` from `/server` (Node only).
- Price-list codes = report-kit template/profile ids plus services/consumables/medicines; `PRICE_LIST` rates are SAMPLE placeholders.
- Amount column = qty × rate − line discount; bill discount, GST and round-off appear in the totals.
- Write currency as `Rs.` (no ₹ glyph in the font). Run `npm run smoke` after changes; it verifies arithmetic, fit, glyphs and that every value appears in the PDF text.

- [src/price-list.ts](src/price-list.ts): PRICE_LIST
- [src/model.ts](src/model.ts): rows, columns, totals, pagination
- [src/types.ts](src/types.ts): data model
